snippet.title: Loot Hole - Gameplay Trailer | Cozy co-op digging game
snippet.description:
Dig up your own front yard in first person, alone or with friends, and see what's buried below. Haul your finds up to the yard stall, sell them, buy better tools and dig deeper, through clay, stone and crystal caves, past secret rooms, all the way down to the Core.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5389630/
Play free in your browser: https://playgama.com/game/loot-hole
Press kit: https://saltedcaramelgames.com/press/loot-hole/

Over 190 finds to collect, online co-op for up to four, a dog that digs up treasure with you, dynamite, jetpacks and ten tools from a rusty shovel to a core drill. Full controller support, 23 languages.

#LootHole #indiegame #cozygames
